title: Phase 2 Behavioral Characterization of Bicameral & Multi-Agent Architectures

hypotheses.H1: Condition B propagates contamination farther than Condition A due to raw transmission boundary.
hypotheses.H2: Condition C reduces propagation depth relative to B through validation and sanitization.
hypotheses.H3: Condition D increases false-consensus risk when lineage is shared across council reviewers.
hypotheses.H4: Condition E improves anticipation of supervisory constraints but risks authority-mimicry.
hypotheses.H5: Agent K detects observable contamination across conditions without inspecting private reasoning.
hypotheses.H6: Deterministic governance remains final authority regardless of agent consensus.
